title: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022 within the 5 departments
question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022 within the 5 departments that offer the largest number of unique subjects this year, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, the department code, number of unique subjects, average total units of their offered subjects, and a status indicating whether the department's average total units is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 10% higher than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 10% lower), or 'AVERAGE' (otherwise). Additionally, for each of these departments, include a grand total of the average academic year for all subjects in that department in the format of (null subject title, department name, null term code, academic year, total average academic year, department code, number of unique subjects, average total units, unit status). Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH fall_2022_terms AS (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
  WHERE TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2022-2023'
),
dep_subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN fall_2022_terms t ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
top_5_depts AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_unique_subjects, avg_total_units
  FROM dep_subject_counts
  ORDER BY num_unique_subjects DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN fall_2022_terms t ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
),
subject_details AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    t.TERM_START_DATE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN fall_2022_terms t ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  JOIN top_5_depts d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
year_groups AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS avg_academic_year,
    MIN(TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date
  FROM subject_details
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT
    sd.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sd.term_code,
    sd.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    yg.avg_academic_year,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.num_unique_subjects,
    d.avg_total_units,
    CASE
      WHEN d.avg_total_units >= oa.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE'
      WHEN d.avg_total_units <= oa.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE'
      ELSE 'AVERAGE'
    END AS unit_status
  FROM subject_details sd
  JOIN year_groups yg ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = yg.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yg.ACADEMIC_YEAR
  JOIN top_5_depts d ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
)

WITH base AS (

         c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         c.SUBJECT_ID,
         c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
         c.TERM_CODE,
         c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
         c.TOTAL_UNITS,
         t.TERM_START_DATE
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
),
dept_uniq AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS uniq_cnt
  FROM base
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
top5 AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM dept_uniq
  ORDER BY uniq_cnt DESC, DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LIMIT 5
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT b.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         COUNT(DISTINCT b.SUBJECT_ID) AS uniq_cnt,
         AVG(b.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units
  FROM base b
  JOIN top5 t ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = b.DEPARTMENT_CODE

),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM base
)
